quotes.text: whirlwinds of the desert stained its bosom. Its blue expanse looked as if it had sprung at the moment from the holy caves where the spirits of the dead drink the waters of immortality. It was one calm sheet of crystal, one broad pellueid mirror of the cloudless heaven, calm as the prosperity of our land of luxuriance, and perennial as the fate which had commanded Egypt to be the queen of nations…
